title: Ethical Challenges in Data-Driven Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating dialogue datasets and model-generated responses using pre-trained linguistic bias detection frameworks, sentiment analysis (VADER), and hate speech/offensive language classifiers.
Prompting language models with stereotypically male-biased and female-biased professions as triggers and calculating the co-occurrence of gender-specific words in the generated follow-up utterances.
